event.location_text: MALACCA STRAIT Approx. 8.5 nm northwest of Tanjung Tondang, Pulau Bintan (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane TSS Indonesia 01° 15.43' N 104° 11.50' E
event.loss: The crew was not injured. Scrap metal was stolen.

sources.title: Piracy monthly report August 2024
sources.text: While towed by HK Tug 3, the barge, LKH 3883 was boarded by unknown number of perpetrators from several small boats. The perpetrators transferred scrap metal from the barge to the small boats and left after about half an hour. The crew was not injured. The incident was reported to the Singapore Port Operations Control Centre (POCC).
